scope: Provider-only pre-window invalidation correction following the isolated UIKit attachment provider review.
supersedes_only: The window-presence invalidation gate recorded in selection-provider-isolation-followup.json. Prior receipt and tested hashes are retained unchanged.
diagnosis: An off-main measurement may return the finite1pt placeholder before the owner text view enters a window. Its deferred main measurement must invalidate TextKit even during pre-window layout; dropping that invalidation could leave cached placeholder geometry until another layout event.
correction: Removed only the window-presence gate. The deferred MainActor task now unwraps the weak owner and requires a nonnil attachmentEnvironment before invalidating TextKit and notifying intrinsic layout.

lifecycle_evidence.teardown: Remote source read confirms dismantleUIView invokes view.setAttachmentEnvironment(nil), after removing the selection callbacks and Markdown controller.
lifecycle_evidence.notification: attachmentSizeDidChange performs invalidateCachedSize(), invalidateIntrinsicContentSize(), and setNeedsLayout(); none requires a mounted window.
lifecycle_evidence.invariant: A live pre-window owner receives the geometry invalidation; a deallocated owner or dismantled owner with a cleared environment receives no invalidation.
